nodes.title: GAME STATE MAP
code:
; GAME STATE MAP
; Every variable the game uses, one page at $C000. The other code
; blocks use these names; change an address here and they follow.
; BootTitle clears $C000-$C0FD for every new game.

PLAYER_XL   = $C000   ; ship X, low byte (sprite coordinates)
PLAYER_XH   = $C001   ; ship X, ninth bit (0 or 1)
PLAYER_Y    = $C002   ; ship Y
SHIP_STEP   = $C003   ; pixels the ship moves this frame
SHIP_TILT   = $C004   ; 0 level, 1 banking left, 2 banking right
PLAYER_BOOM = $C005   ; ship explosion timer, 0 = flying
INVULN      = $C006   ; frames of safety left (respawn / shield)
LIVES       = $C007   ; ships left
FIRE_LATCH  = $C008   ; 1 while fire is held (tap-fire mode)
KEY_LATCH   = $C009   ; 1 while the power key is held
ANIM        = $C00A   ; counts frames, drives every animation
SCROLL_TICK = $C00B   ; counts frames for the slow scroll
SCORE1      = $C00C   ; score: hundreds + thousands (BCD)
SCORE2      = $C00D   ; score: 10 thousands + 100 thousands (BCD)
EN_BOOM     = $C00E   ; explosion timer per enemy slot (SPN slot 0-2) (3 bytes)
EN_BXL      = $C011   ; where that explosion is: X low byte (3 bytes)
EN_BXH      = $C014   ; X ninth bit (3 bytes)
EN_BY       = $C017   ; Y (3 bytes)
SHOT_ON     = $C01A   ; main shot / laser flying
SHOT_XL     = $C01B
SHOT_XH     = $C01C
SHOT_Y      = $C01D
DBL_ON      = $C01E   ; DOUBLE shot flying
DBL_XL      = $C01F
DBL_XH      = $C020
DBL_Y       = $C021
MSL_ON      = $C022   ; MISSILE flying
MSL_XL      = $C023
MSL_XH      = $C024
MSL_Y       = $C025
MSL_TGT     = $C026   ; SPAWNER slot the homing MISSILE chases
OPT_XL      = $C027   ; OPTION position
OPT_XH      = $C028
OPT_Y       = $C029
CAP_ON      = $C02A   ; a capsule is out
CAP_SLOT    = $C02B   ; enemy slot whose sprite it borrows
CAP_XL      = $C02C
CAP_XH      = $C02D
CAP_Y       = $C02E
METER       = $C02F   ; lit power meter slot, 0 = none, 1-6
POWERS      = $C030   ; owned powers, one byte per meter slot: (6 bytes)
SPEEDUPS    = $C030   ;   SPEED: speed-ups taken
HAS_MISSILE = $C031   ;   MISSILE owned
HAS_DOUBLE  = $C032   ;   DOUBLE owned
HAS_LASER   = $C033   ;   LASER owned
HAS_OPTION  = $C034   ;   OPTION owned
SHIELD      = $C035   ;   SHIELD: hits left
TRAIL_POS   = $C036   ; newest entry of the OPTION trail
PROBE_XL    = $C037   ; ProbeChar input point
PROBE_XH    = $C038
PROBE_Y     = $C039
PROBE_COL   = $C03A   ; ProbeChar scratch
PROBE_CHAR  = $C03B
BOX_XL      = $C03C   ; BoxTest first sprite
BOX_XH      = $C03D
BOX_Y       = $C03E
BOX_W       = $C03F   ; BoxTest hit distance X
BOX_H       = $C040   ; BoxTest hit distance Y
TGT_XL      = $C041   ; BoxTest second sprite
TGT_XH      = $C042
TGT_Y       = $C043
D_XL        = $C044   ; PutSprite inputs
D_XH        = $C045
D_Y         = $C046
D_PTR       = $C047
D_COL       = $C048
SPR_ON      = $C049   ; $D015 being built
SPR_MSB     = $C04A   ; $D010 being built
T0          = $C04B   ; scratch
T1          = $C04C
T2          = $C04D

; OPTION trail: 32 remembered ship positions
TRAIL_XL    = $C080
TRAIL_XH    = $C0A0
TRAIL_Y     = $C0C0

; Enemy shots (ENEMY FIRE), 6 of each per-shot byte
ES_ON       = $C100   ; enemy shot flying (6 bytes)
ES_X        = $C106   ; X in 2-pixel steps from the screen edge (0-159) (6 bytes)
ES_XF       = $C10C   ; X fraction (6 bytes)
ES_Y        = $C112   ; Y (sprite coordinates) (6 bytes)
ES_YF       = $C118   ; Y fraction (6 bytes)
ES_VXL      = $C11E   ; X speed, 8.8 signed (6 bytes)
ES_VXH      = $C124
ES_VYL      = $C12A   ; Y speed, 8.8 signed (6 bytes)
ES_VYH      = $C130
ES_SHOWN    = $C136   ; 1 = drawn on the screen at ES_AL/ES_AH (6 bytes)
ES_AL       = $C13C   ; screen address of the drawn shot (6 bytes)
ES_AH       = $C142
ES_UNDER    = $C148   ; the char it covers, put back by EraseShots (6 bytes)
ES_TICK     = $C14E   ; frames to the next shot
ES_NEXT     = $C14F   ; enemy slot that shoots next
ES_AX       = $C150   ; aim: |dx|
ES_AY       = $C151   ; aim: |dy|
ES_SX       = $C152   ; aim: 1 = dx negative
ES_SY       = $C153   ; aim: 1 = dy negative
ES_K        = $C154   ; aim: angle from level, 22.5 degree steps
SHIP_CX     = $C155   ; the ship's centre in shot units
SHIP_CY     = $C156

; High score - outside the cleared range so it survives a game over
HI1         = $C0FE   ; hundreds + thousands (BCD)
HI2         = $C0FF   ; 10 thousands + 100 thousands (BCD)

nodes.title: READ ME
code:
SHMUP V - READ ME
A vertical shooter, the twin of SHMUP H: the same power meter, weapons and spawn layer, flown up a canyon that scrolls down.

Each box is one job of the game. The heading comment says what it does, the yellow arrows point at the nodes that matter.

ASSETS (all editable):
TILES     charset + tags
WORLD     the level map
ACTORS    every sprite
FRONT_END title picture
STATUS    the HUD
MUSIC_AND_SFX title tune
GAME_SFX  sound effects

WORLD also holds the SPAWN layer: press E in it to place and edit enemies.

The CONTROL panels below hold every setting (F9 = Creator view): screen, scroll, ship, power meter, weapons, enemy fire, rules, colours and HUD. Change a value, rebuild with F5.

PLAY: joystick port 2. Shoot a RED FAN for a capsule; SPACE buys the lit power.

nodes.title: STARTUP
code:
STARTUP
The spine starts at SYSTEM INIT, banks BASIC out and jumps to the title. The four raster IRQs that pin the HUD are set up from here too.

nodes.title: BOOT + HUD SPLIT
code:
; STARTUP - MAIN SPINE - BOOT + HUD SPLIT
; State: HI1 HI2
;
; Bank BASIC out, clear the high score (power-on RAM is random),
; then straight to the title screen.
LDA #$36
STA $01
LDA #$00
STA HI1
STA HI2
JMP BootTitle

; InstallHudSplit - called once per game from GAME SETUP.
; Stops the CIA timer IRQs, points NMI at a bare RTI and banks
; out the KERNAL ($01 = $35). The HUD RASTER HANDLER macro below
; finishes the job by installing the four raster IRQs.
InstallHudSplit:
SEI
LDA #$7F
STA $DC0D
STA $DD0D
LDA $DC0D
LDA $DD0D
LDA #<HudNmi
STA $FFFA
LDA #>HudNmi
STA $FFFB
LDA #$1B
STA $D011
LDA #$08
STA $D016
LDA #$35
STA $01

BOOT / TITLE

nodes.title: BOOT TITLE
code:
; BOOT / TITLE - BOOT TITLE
;
; BootTitle - also where a game over comes back to.
BootTitle:
SEI
CLD
LDX #$FF         ; fresh stack: a game over jumps here mid-call
TXS
LDA #$36
.byte $8D,$01,$00 ; STA $0001 (absolute, as SHMUP V)
LDA #$00
STA $D01A        ; no raster IRQs on the title
STA $D015        ; no sprites
LDA #$FF
STA $D019
; Clear GAME STATE ($C000-$C0FD). $C0FE/$C0FF keep the high score.
LDA #$00
LDX #$00
ClearState:
STA $C000,X
INX
CPX #$FE
BNE ClearState
; Port 2 as input, keyboard rows released.
LDA #$00
STA $DC02
LDA #$FF
STA $DC00

AND #$10

TitleRelease:
JSR TitleFrame
LDA $DC00

TitleFrame:

Screen mode and charset, the scrolling WORLD, the sprites and the HUD. Then a new game starts.

nodes.title: NEW GAME
code:
; GAME SETUP - NEW GAME
; State: LIVES SCORE1 SCORE2 ES_SHOWN
;
; A fresh game: ships and score, then into the loop.
START_LIVES = 3

; Every sprite hires, in front of the scenery, not expanded.
LDA #$00
STA $D01B
STA $D01C
STA $D017
STA $D01D
LDA #START_LIVES
STA LIVES
LDA #$00
STA SCORE1
STA SCORE2
; the screen is fresh: no enemy shot is drawn on it
LDX #$05
ClearShown:
STA ES_SHOWN,X
DEX
BPL ClearShown
; The climb starts at the bottom of the WORLD map ($61 = the camera's
; map row): LOOP_ROW, whose rows repeat the top of the map.
LDA #$80
STA $61
JSR ResetActors
JSR DrawActors
JSR InstallHudSplit
JMP GameLoop

ASSET: TILES

ASSET: WORLD
The level: 2x2 stamps, 20 x 76, flown bottom to top. Paint it in the tileset editor. The bottom 12 rows must repeat the top 12 - that is where the level loops (LOOP_ROW, FRAME LOOP).

nodes.title: FRAME LOOP
code:
FRAME LOOP
Game logic once a frame, then wait for the border to draw the sprites and scroll the world down.

nodes.title: GAME LOOP
code:
; FRAME LOOP - GAME LOOP
;
; One pass = one frame. All the game logic runs here, while the
; screen is still being drawn; drawing and scrolling wait for the
; bottom border (FRAME SYNC below).
GameLoop:
JSR SfxTick
JSR Effects
JSR Input
JSR PowerKey
JSR Enemy
JSR EnemyFire
JSR Weapons
JSR OptionMove
JSR Hits
JSR Capsule
JSR Status

nodes.title: DRAW + SCROLL
code:
; FRAME LOOP - DRAW + SCROLL
; State: SCROLL_TICK CAP_Y
;
; In the border: place the sprites, then scroll the world.
; Scroll speed - on the SCROLL panel.
SCROLL_SPEED = 1   ; 0 slow (1 pixel every 2 frames), 1 normal, 2 fast

JSR DrawActors
; enemy shots are chars: off the screen while it scrolls, then back on
JSR EraseShots
.IF SCROLL_SPEED == 0
INC SCROLL_TICK
LDA SCROLL_TICK
AND #$01
BEQ ScrollDone
JSR ScrollStep
.ENDIF
.IF SCROLL_SPEED >= 1
JSR ScrollStep
.ENDIF
.IF SCROLL_SPEED >= 2
JSR ScrollStep
.ENDIF
ScrollDone:
JSR DrawShots
JMP GameLoop

; ScrollStep - the world moves one pixel down.
; MSC_U moves the WORLD SCROLLER camera up, MSC_Update finishes a
; coarse (whole char) step. $61 is the camera's map row; the climb
; starts at LOOP_ROW (NEW GAME). The WORLD map's bottom rows repeat
; its top rows, so when the camera reaches row 0 it can jump back to
; LOOP_ROW without the screen changing.
LOOP_ROW = $80
ScrollStep:
LDA $61
BNE ScrollGo
LDA #LOOP_ROW
STA $61
ScrollGo:
JSR MSC_U
JSR MSC_Update
; A capsule sits in the world, so it drifts down with it; so do
; the SPAWNER's TANK (WALKER) and TURRET entities (SPN_Scroll).
JSR SPN_Scroll
INC CAP_Y
RTS

nodes.title: RESPAWN
code:
RESPAWN
A fresh ship at the bottom, weapons and enemies cleared, a moment of safety.

nodes.title: RESET ACTORS
code:
; RESPAWN - RESET ACTORS
; State: PLAYER_XL PLAYER_XH PLAYER_Y SHIP_TILT PLAYER_BOOM
;        INVULN EN_BOOM SHOT_ON DBL_ON MSL_ON CAP_ON METER
;        POWERS TRAIL_XL TRAIL_XH TRAIL_Y ES_ON ES_TICK
;
; ResetActors - a new ship at the bottom of the screen.
; On the SHIP panel:
KEEP_POWERS = 0     ; 0 = a lost ship loses its power-ups (Nemesis rules)
RESPAWN_SAFE = 100  ; frames the new ship cannot be hit

ResetActors:
LDA #$A0
STA PLAYER_XL
LDA #$00
STA PLAYER_XH
LDA #$D0
STA PLAYER_Y
LDA #$00
STA PLAYER_BOOM
STA SHIP_TILT
STA SHOT_ON
STA DBL_ON
STA MSL_ON
STA CAP_ON
.IF KEEP_POWERS == 0
STA METER
LDX #$05
ClearPowers:
STA POWERS,X
DEX
BPL ClearPowers
.ENDIF
LDX #$02
ClearBooms:
STA EN_BOOM,X
DEX
BPL ClearBooms
LDX #$05
ClearShots:
STA ES_ON,X
DEX
BPL ClearShots
; The SPAWNER clears its slots and relaunches what is on screen.
JSR SPN_Reset
LDA #$40
STA ES_TICK
LDA #RESPAWN_SAFE
STA INVULN
; Fill the OPTION trail with the new position.
LDX #$1F
FillTrail:
LDA PLAYER_XL
STA TRAIL_XL,X
LDA PLAYER_XH
STA TRAIL_XH,X
LDA PLAYER_Y
STA TRAIL_Y,X
DEX
BPL FillTrail
RTS

nodes.title: JOYSTICK / FIRE
code:
JOYSTICK / FIRE
Port 2. The JOYSTICK macro calls a Joy... label per direction; diagonals call two. Fire launches every free weapon.

nodes.title: INPUT
code:
; JOYSTICK / FIRE - INPUT
; State: SHIP_STEP SHIP_TILT PLAYER_BOOM SPEEDUPS
;
; Input - the JOYSTICK macro below reads port 2 into $F8 and calls
; one of the Joy... labels for the direction held.
; Ship speed in pixels per frame - on the SHIP panel.
SHIP_SPEED = 2

Input:
LDA PLAYER_BOOM
BEQ InputAlive
RTS
InputAlive:
; This frame's step = SHIP_SPEED + SPEED power-ups taken.
LDA #SHIP_SPEED
CLC
ADC SPEEDUPS
STA SHIP_STEP
LDA #$00
STA SHIP_TILT

nodes.title: FIRE
code:
; JOYSTICK / FIRE - FIRE
; State: FIRE_LATCH
;
; Fire. Hold fire for auto-fire, or tap mode: one press, one shot.
AUTO_FIRE = 1     ; on the SHIP panel

LDA $F8           ; joystick bits from the JOYSTICK macro, 0 = pressed
AND #$10
BNE FireReleased
.IF AUTO_FIRE == 0
LDA FIRE_LATCH
BNE InputDone
LDA #$01
STA FIRE_LATCH
.ENDIF
JMP FireWeapons   ; launches whatever is free (WEAPONS column)
FireReleased:
LDA #$00
STA FIRE_LATCH
InputDone:
RTS

nodes.title: MOVE LEFT
code:
; JOYSTICK / FIRE - MOVE LEFT
; State: PLAYER_XL PLAYER_XH SHIP_STEP SHIP_TILT
;
; Left, as far as X_MIN. X is 9 bits: PLAYER_XL + PLAYER_XH.
; Banks the ship.
X_MIN = $18

LDA #$01
STA SHIP_TILT
LDA PLAYER_XL
SEC
SBC SHIP_STEP
STA PLAYER_XL
LDA PLAYER_XH
SBC #$00
STA PLAYER_XH
BMI JoyLeftClamp
BNE JoyLeftDone
LDA PLAYER_XL
CMP #X_MIN
BCS JoyLeftDone
JoyLeftClamp:
LDA #X_MIN
STA PLAYER_XL
LDA #$00
STA PLAYER_XH
JoyLeftDone:
RTS

nodes.title: MOVE RIGHT
code:
; JOYSTICK / FIRE - MOVE RIGHT
; State: PLAYER_XL PLAYER_XH SHIP_STEP SHIP_TILT
;
; Right, as far as $100 + X_MAX_LO (the right edge of the 40-column
; screen is X = $140 for a sprite's left side). Banks the ship.
X_MAX_LO = $40

LDA #$02
STA SHIP_TILT
LDA PLAYER_XL
CLC
ADC SHIP_STEP
STA PLAYER_XL
LDA PLAYER_XH
ADC #$00
STA PLAYER_XH
BEQ JoyRightDone
LDA PLAYER_XL
CMP #X_MAX_LO
BCC JoyRightDone
LDA #X_MAX_LO
STA PLAYER_XL
JoyRightDone:
RTS

nodes.title: MOVE UP
code:
; JOYSTICK / FIRE - MOVE UP
; State: PLAYER_Y SHIP_STEP
;
; Up, no higher than Y_MIN (a good way below the HUD, so enemies
; coming down can be seen in time).
Y_MIN = $60

LDA PLAYER_Y
SEC
SBC SHIP_STEP
CMP #Y_MIN
BCS JoyUpStore
LDA #Y_MIN
JoyUpStore:
STA PLAYER_Y
RTS

nodes.title: MOVE DOWN
code:
; JOYSTICK / FIRE - MOVE DOWN
; State: PLAYER_Y SHIP_STEP
;
; Down, no lower than Y_MAX (the bottom of the screen).
Y_MAX = $E0

LDA PLAYER_Y
CLC
ADC SHIP_STEP
CMP #Y_MAX
BCC JoyDownStore
LDA #Y_MAX
JoyDownStore:
STA PLAYER_Y
RTS

nodes.title: Fire + direction rows are
code: Fire + direction rows are off, so fire never blocks movement: the FIRE block reads fire after the move.

nodes.title: Diagonals: one JSR for the
code: Diagonals: one JSR for the side step, then JMP to the up/down routine, whose RTS returns to the macro.

nodes.title: X is 9 bits: the screen is
code: X is 9 bits: the screen is 320 pixels wide, a byte only reaches 255. Each move clamps to the edges (X_MIN, X_MAX_LO, Y_MIN, Y_MAX). Left and right bank the ship.

nodes.title: POWER METER
code:
POWER METER
Capsules light the next meter slot. The power key buys the lit one:
SPEED MISSL DOUBL LASER OPTN SHLD.

nodes.title: POWER KEY
code:
; POWER METER - POWER KEY
; State: KEY_LATCH
;
; PowerKey - the key that cashes in the lit meter slot.
POWER_KEY = 0      ; on the POWER METER panel: 0 SPACE, 1 RETURN, 2 C=

.IF POWER_KEY == 0
KEY_ROW = $7F
KEY_BIT = $10
.ENDIF
.IF POWER_KEY == 1
KEY_ROW = $FE
KEY_BIT = $02
.ENDIF
.IF POWER_KEY == 2
KEY_ROW = $7F
KEY_BIT = $20
.ENDIF

PowerKey:
LDA #$FF
STA $DC02        ; port A drives the keyboard rows for a moment
LDA #KEY_ROW
STA $DC00
LDA $DC01        ; the row's keys, 0 = pressed
LDX #$FF
STX $DC00
LDX #$00
STX $DC02        ; port A back to input for the joystick
AND #KEY_BIT
BNE KeyUp
LDA KEY_LATCH    ; one power per press
BNE KeyDone
LDA #$01
STA KEY_LATCH
JMP ApplyPower
KeyUp:
LDA #$00
STA KEY_LATCH
KeyDone:
RTS

nodes.title: APPLY POWER
code:
; POWER METER - APPLY POWER
; State: METER SPEEDUPS HAS_MISSILE HAS_DOUBLE HAS_LASER
;        HAS_OPTION SHIELD
;
; ApplyPower - turn the lit slot into its power-up.
; Slots: 1 SPEED  2 MISSILE  3 DOUBLE  4 LASER  5 OPTION  6 SHIELD
; A power you already own is refused and the slot stays lit.
; On the POWER METER panel:
MAX_SPEEDUPS = 3   ; SPEED can be taken this many times
SHIELD_HITS = 3    ; hits a SHIELD soaks up

ApplyPower:
LDA METER
BNE PowerPick
RTS
PowerPick:
CMP #$01
BEQ PowSpeed
CMP #$02
BEQ PowMissile
CMP #$03
BEQ PowDouble
CMP #$04
BEQ PowLaser
CMP #$05
BEQ PowOption
; 6 = SHIELD, always refills
LDA #SHIELD_HITS
STA SHIELD
JMP PowerTaken

PowSpeed:
LDA SPEEDUPS
CMP #MAX_SPEEDUPS
BCS PowerRefused
INC SPEEDUPS
JMP PowerTaken

PowMissile:
LDA HAS_MISSILE
BNE PowerRefused
INC HAS_MISSILE
JMP PowerTaken

; DOUBLE and LASER replace each other.
PowDouble:
LDA HAS_DOUBLE
BNE PowerRefused
LDA #$01
STA HAS_DOUBLE
LDA #$00
STA HAS_LASER
JMP PowerTaken

PowLaser:
LDA HAS_LASER
BNE PowerRefused
LDA #$01
STA HAS_LASER
LDA #$00
STA HAS_DOUBLE
JMP PowerTaken

PowOption:
LDA HAS_OPTION
BNE PowerRefused
INC HAS_OPTION

PowerTaken:
LDA #$00
STA METER
JMP PowerSound
PowerRefused:
RTS

nodes.title: CAPSULE
code:
; POWER METER - CAPSULE
; State: PLAYER_BOOM EN_BOOM CAP_ON CAP_SLOT CAP_XL CAP_XH CAP_Y
;        METER BOX_XL BOX_XH BOX_Y BOX_W BOX_H
;
; Capsule - dropped by an entity whose type has a DROP (the RED FAN in
; the WORLD map's spawn layer). It borrows that enemy slot's sprite,
; drifts down with the world (ScrollStep) and lights the next meter
; slot when you fly into it.
Capsule:
LDA CAP_ON
BNE CapsuleLive
RTS
CapsuleLive:
; gone off the bottom?
LDA CAP_Y
CMP #$F0
BCC CapsuleShown
LDA #$00
STA CAP_ON
RTS
; hidden while its slot shows an explosion or a new enemy
CapsuleShown:
LDY CAP_SLOT
LDA EN_BOOM,Y
ORA SPN_ON,Y
ORA PLAYER_BOOM
BNE CapsuleDone
LDA CAP_XL
STA BOX_XL
LDA CAP_XH
STA BOX_XH
LDA CAP_Y
STA BOX_Y
LDA #$10
STA BOX_W
STA BOX_H
JSR BoxVsShip
BCS CapsuleDone
; collected: light the next slot, 6 wraps round to 1
LDA #$00
STA CAP_ON
INC METER
LDA METER
CMP #$07
BCC CapsuleGot
LDA #$01
STA METER
CapsuleGot:
JMP CapsuleSound
CapsuleDone:
RTS

nodes.title: The keyboard shares CIA 1
code: The keyboard shares CIA 1 with the joystick: the row is selected for one read, then port A goes back to input for the stick.

nodes.title: A capsule borrows the
code: A capsule borrows the sprite (5-7) of the enemy that dropped it. It hides while the SPAWNER flies a new enemy in that slot.

nodes.title: ATTACK WAVES
code:
ATTACK WAVES
Enemies are placed on the WORLD map (SPAWN layer) and flown by the SPAWNER. This just keeps it fed.

nodes.title: ENEMY FLIGHT
code:
; ATTACK WAVES - ENEMY FLIGHT
; State: PLAYER_XL PLAYER_XH PLAYER_Y ANIM
;
; Enemy - the SPAWNER node (GAME SETUP column) launches the entities
; placed on the WORLD map's SPAWN layer as they scroll in, and flies
; them by their type's movement. Tell it where the ship is - CHASE and
; DIVE home in on SPN_TGT.
Enemy:
INC ANIM
LDA PLAYER_XL
STA SPN_TGT_XL
LDA PLAYER_XH
STA SPN_TGT_XH
LDA PLAYER_Y
STA SPN_TGT_Y
JMP SPN_Update

nodes.title: SPAWNER
code:
SPAWNER
Launches the WORLD map's SPAWN layer as it scrolls in (MODE SCROLL V), into 3 slots = sprites 5-7. Open WORLD, press E to place enemies and edit their types: frame, colour, movement, speed, HP, points, drop.

nodes.title: ASSET: WORLD - SPAWN LAYER
code:
ASSET: WORLD - SPAWN LAYER
Open WORLD, press E. Pick a type, L-click to place, R-click to delete. Each type sets frame, colour, movement + VALUE, speed, HP, points and drop.

nodes.title: Movements: STRAIGHT, SINE,
code: Movements: STRAIGHT, SINE, CHASE, ZIGZAG, DIVE, WALKER (rides the ground, like the TANK) and TURRET (fixed to the map, SPN_FIRE cues shots).

nodes.title: ENEMY FIRE
code:
ENEMY FIRE
Enemies shoot at the ship. The shots are characters, not sprites: all 8 sprites are already taken.

nodes.title: ENEMY FIRE
code:
; ENEMY FIRE - ENEMY FIRE
; State: PLAYER_XL PLAYER_XH PLAYER_Y PLAYER_BOOM INVULN ANIM
;        SHOT_ON SHOT_XL SHOT_XH SHOT_Y DBL_ON DBL_XL DBL_XH
;        DBL_Y MSL_ON MSL_XL MSL_XH MSL_Y T0 T1 T2 ES_ON ES_X
;        ES_XF ES_Y ES_YF ES_VXL ES_VXH ES_VYL ES_VYH ES_TICK
;        ES_NEXT ES_AX ES_AY ES_SX ES_SY ES_K SHIP_CX SHIP_CY
;        HAS_LASER
;
; EnemyFire - the enemies shoot at the ship. All 8 sprites are taken,
; so a shot is a character: a dot drawn into the screen, rubbed out and
; drawn again every frame (SHOT DRAW). Up to 6 fly at once.
; On the ENEMY FIRE panel:
ENEMY_SHOTS = 1       ; 0 = the enemies never shoot
FIRE_RATE = 50        ; frames between shots
ENEMY_SHOT_SPEED = 2  ; pixels per frame
SHOT_CHAR = $78       ; the first of the 16 shot chars in TILES (120-135)

EnemyFire:
.IF ENEMY_SHOTS == 1
; The ship's centre in shot units: X in 2-pixel steps from the left
; edge of the screen, Y as sprites have it.
LDA PLAYER_XL
SEC
SBC #$0C          ; +12 to the middle of the ship, -24 to the edge
STA T0
LDA PLAYER_XH
SBC #$00
LSR
LDA T0
ROR
STA SHIP_CX
LDA PLAYER_Y
CLC
ADC #$0A
STA SHIP_CY
JSR MoveShots
LDA PLAYER_BOOM
BNE EFDone
; TURRET entities fire when the SPAWNER cues them (SPN_FIRE)
LDX #$02
EFCue:
LDA SPN_ON,X
BEQ EFCueNext
LDA SPN_FIRE,X
BEQ EFCueNext
JSR LaunchShot
EFCueNext:
DEX
BPL EFCue
; Every FIRE_RATE frames the next enemy in turn shoots - one that is
; above the ship and far enough away to dodge.
DEC ES_TICK
BNE EFDone
LDA #FIRE_RATE
STA ES_TICK
LDY #$03
EFPick:
LDX ES_NEXT
INX
CPX #$03
BCC EFPickSlot
LDX #$00
EFPickSlot:
STX ES_NEXT
LDA SPN_ON,X
BEQ EFPickNext
LDA SPN_Y,X
CLC
ADC #$20
BCS EFPickNext
CMP PLAYER_Y
BCS EFPickNext
JMP LaunchShot    ; its RTS ends EnemyFire
EFPickNext:
DEY
BNE EFPick
EFDone:
.ENDIF
RTS

; LaunchShot - SPAWNER slot X fires. The four-spoke spinner (the
; FAN types: ACTORS frame 10) sprays four shots along its spokes, any
; other enemy fires one shot at the ship. Keeps X.
SPIN_PTR = $AA        ; the spinner's first frame: $A0 + 10
LaunchShot:
LDY SPN_TYPE,X
LDA SPN_T_PTR,Y
CMP #SPIN_PTR
BNE LaunchAimed
JMP SprayShots
LaunchNone:
RTS
LaunchAimed:
JSR ShotStart
BCS LaunchNone
; aim: |dx| and |dy| to the ship, and their signs
LDA #$00
STA ES_SX
STA ES_SY
LDA SHIP_CX
SEC
SBC ES_X,Y
BCS AimX
EOR #$FF
ADC #$01
INC ES_SX
AimX:
STA ES_AX
LDA SHIP_CY
SEC
SBC ES_Y,Y
BCS AimY
EOR #$FF
ADC #$01
INC ES_SY
AimY:
STA ES_AY
; halve both until they are under 32, so the sums below fit a byte
AimShrink:
LDA ES_AX
CMP #$20
BCS AimHalve
LDA ES_AY
CMP #$20
BCC AimAngle
AimHalve:
LSR ES_AX
LSR ES_AY
JMP AimShrink
; ES_K = the angle from level in 22.5 degree steps, 0-4:
; tan 11.25 is about 1/5, tan 33.75 about 2/3.
AimAngle:
LDA ES_AX
CMP ES_AY
BCC AimSteep
LDA #$00          ; mostly sideways
STA ES_K
LDA ES_AY
ASL
ASL
ADC ES_AY
CMP ES_AX
BCC ShotGo         ; dy * 5 < dx: level
INC ES_K
LDA ES_AY
ASL
ADC ES_AY
STA T0
LDA ES_AX
ASL
CMP T0
BCS ShotGo         ; dy * 3 <= dx * 2: 22.5
INC ES_K
JMP ShotGo         ; 45
AimSteep:
LDA #$04          ; mostly up or down
STA ES_K
LDA ES_AX
ASL
ASL
ADC ES_AX
CMP ES_AY
BCC ShotGo         ; dx * 5 < dy: straight
DEC ES_K
LDA ES_AX
ASL
ADC ES_AX
STA T0
LDA ES_AY
ASL
CMP T0
BCS ShotGo         ; 67.5
DEC ES_K          ; 45
; ShotGo - shot Y flies at angle ES_K (0 level - 4 straight up or
; down, 22.5 degrees a step), X negative if ES_SX, Y negative if ES_SY.
ShotGo:
STX T1
LDX ES_K
LDA AimVX,X
STA ES_VXL,Y
LDA #$00
STA ES_VXH,Y
LDA AimVYL,X
STA ES_VYL,Y
LDA AimVYH,X
STA ES_VYH,Y
LDX T1
LDA ES_SX
BEQ AimXSign
LDA #$00
SEC
SBC ES_VXL,Y
STA ES_VXL,Y
LDA #$00
SBC ES_VXH,Y
STA ES_VXH,Y
AimXSign:
LDA ES_SY
BEQ AimYSign
LDA #$00
SEC
SBC ES_VYL,Y
STA ES_VYL,Y
LDA #$00
SBC ES_VYH,Y
STA ES_VYH,Y
AimYSign:
LDA #$01
STA ES_ON,Y
RTS

; ShotStart - a free shot (Y) at the middle of SPAWNER slot X.
; Carry set: no shot (all flying, or the enemy is off the playfield).
ShotStart:
LDY #$05
SSFind:
LDA ES_ON,Y
BEQ SSFree
DEY
BPL SSFind
SSNone:
SEC
RTS
SSFree:
LDA SPN_Y,X
CLC
ADC #$0A
CMP #$5A
BCC SSNone
CMP #$F0
BCS SSNone
STA ES_Y,Y
LDA SPN_XL,X
SEC
SBC #$0C
STA T0
LDA SPN_XH,X
SBC #$00
BMI SSNone
LSR
LDA T0
ROR
CMP #$A0
BCS SSNone
STA ES_X,Y
LDA #$80
STA ES_XF,Y
STA ES_YF,Y
CLC
RTS

; SprayShots - spinner slot X fires along its four spokes. It is drawn
; as an X (frame +0) or a + (frame +1), swapped every 8 frames: the X
; shoots the diagonals, the + straight across and up and down.
SprayShots:
LDA ANIM
LSR
AND #$04          ; frame +1: spokes 4-7
STA T2
LDA #$04
STA ES_AX         ; spokes to go
SprayLoop:
JSR ShotStart
BCS SprayDone
STX ES_AY
LDX T2
LDA SprayK,X
STA ES_K
LDA SpraySX,X
STA ES_SX
LDA SpraySY,X
STA ES_SY
LDX ES_AY
JSR ShotGo
INC T2
DEC ES_AX
BNE SprayLoop
SprayDone:
RTS
; spokes 0-3: the X, 4-7: the +
SprayK:
.byte $02,$02,$02,$02,$00,$00,$04,$04
SpraySX:
.byte $00,$01,$00,$01,$00,$01,$00,$00
SpraySY:
.byte $00,$00,$01,$01,$00,$00,$00,$01

; 1 pixel per frame at each angle, 8.8: X in shot units (2 pixels),
; so cos / 2; Y in pixels, sin.
AimVX:
.byte $80,$76,$5B,$31,$00
AimVYL:
.byte $00,$62,$B5,$ED,$00
AimVYH:
.byte $00,$00,$00,$00,$01

; MoveShots - ENEMY_SHOT_SPEED steps a frame; off the playfield they go,
; into the ship they cost a life (or a SHIELD hit).
MoveShots:
LDX #$05
ESMove:
LDA ES_ON,X
BNE ESLive
JMP ESNext
ESLive:
LDY #ENEMY_SHOT_SPEED
ESStep:
LDA ES_XF,X
CLC
ADC ES_VXL,X
STA ES_XF,X
LDA ES_X,X
ADC ES_VXH,X
STA ES_X,X
LDA ES_YF,X
CLC
ADC ES_VYL,X
STA ES_YF,X
LDA ES_Y,X
ADC ES_VYH,X
STA ES_Y,X
DEY
BNE ESStep
LDA ES_X,X
CMP #$A0          ; past either side (left wraps round to $FF)
BCS ESOff
LDA ES_Y,X
CMP #$5A          ; up into the band under the HUD
BCC ESOff
CMP #$F4          ; the bottom border
BCS ESOff
JMP ESInside
ESOff:
LDA #$00
STA ES_ON,X
JMP ESNext
ESInside:
; our shot, DOUBLE or MISSILE meets it: both are gone (a LASER keeps
; going)
LDA SHOT_ON
BEQ ESCDouble
LDA SHOT_XL
STA T0
LDA SHOT_XH
STA T1
LDA SHOT_Y
STA T2
JSR ShotVsWeapon
BCS ESCDouble
LDA HAS_LASER
BNE ESCancel
LDA #$00
STA SHOT_ON
JMP ESCancel
ESCDouble:
LDA DBL_ON
BEQ ESCMissile
LDA DBL_XL
STA T0
LDA DBL_XH
STA T1
LDA DBL_Y
STA T2
JSR ShotVsWeapon
BCS ESCMissile
LDA #$00
STA DBL_ON
JMP ESCancel
ESCMissile:
LDA MSL_ON
BEQ ESShip
LDA MSL_XL
STA T0
LDA MSL_XH
STA T1
LDA MSL_Y
STA T2
JSR ShotVsWeapon
BCS ESShip
LDA #$00
STA MSL_ON
ESCancel:
LDA #$00
STA ES_ON,X
JMP ESNext
ESShip:
LDA PLAYER_BOOM
ORA INVULN
BNE ESNext
LDA ES_X,X        ; within 8 pixels across...
SEC
SBC SHIP_CX
CLC
ADC #$03
CMP #$07
BCS ESNext
LDA ES_Y,X        ; ...and 7 down
SEC
SBC SHIP_CY
CLC
ADC #$07
CMP #$0E
BCS ESNext
LDA #$00
STA ES_ON,X
JSR ShipHit
JMP ESNext
ESNext:
DEX
BMI ESDone
JMP ESMove
ESDone:
RTS

; ShotVsWeapon - does enemy shot X touch our weapon sprite at
; T0/T1 (X, 9 bits) / T2 (Y)? Carry clear: yes. Within 10 pixels each
; way of the sprite's middle (+12, +9); the shot's middle is +2, +2.
ShotVsWeapon:
LDA T0
SEC
SBC #$0E          ; +12 to the middle, -24 to the edge, -2 for the shot
STA T0
LDA T1
SBC #$00
BMI SVWMiss
LSR
LDA T0
ROR               ; in shot units (2 pixels)
SEC
SBC ES_X,X
CLC
ADC #$05
CMP #$0B
BCS SVWMiss
LDA T2
CLC
ADC #$07          ; +9 to the middle, -2 for the shot
SEC
SBC ES_Y,X
CLC
ADC #$0A
CMP #$15
BCS SVWMiss
CLC
RTS
SVWMiss:
SEC
RTS

nodes.title: SHOT DRAW
code:
; ENEMY FIRE - SHOT DRAW
; State: PROBE_XL PROBE_XH PROBE_Y PROBE_CHAR T0 T1 ES_ON ES_X
;        ES_Y ES_SHOWN ES_AL ES_AH ES_UNDER
;
; EraseShots - before the WORLD SCROLLER moves the screen: put back the
; char under every drawn shot, so the scroll never carries a shot along.
EraseShots:
LDX #$05
ESErase:
LDA ES_SHOWN,X
BEQ ESEraseNext
LDA ES_AL,X
STA $FB
LDA ES_AH,X
STA $FC
LDA ES_UNDER,X
LDY #$00
STA ($FB),Y
TYA
STA ES_SHOWN,X
ESEraseNext:
DEX
BPL ESErase
RTS

; DrawShots - after the scroll: each flying shot into the screen. A shot
; that meets a tagged char (rock, a bunker) is gone; one that meets
; another shot waits a frame.
DrawShots:
LDX #$05
ESDraw:
LDA ES_ON,X
BEQ ESDrawNext
LDA ES_X,X        ; sprite X = 24 + 2 * X
ASL
STA T0
LDA #$00
ROL
STA T1
LDA T0
CLC
ADC #$18
STA PROBE_XL
LDA T1
ADC #$00
STA PROBE_XH
LDA ES_Y,X
STA PROBE_Y
JSR ProbeChar
BEQ ESFree
LDA #$00
STA ES_ON,X
JMP ESDrawNext
ESFree:
LDA PROBE_CHAR
SEC
SBC #SHOT_CHAR
CMP #$10
BCC ESDrawNext
LDA $FB
STA ES_AL,X
LDA $FC
STA ES_AH,X
LDA PROBE_CHAR
STA ES_UNDER,X
LDA #$01
STA ES_SHOWN,X
; which shot char: 2-pixel steps down and across the cell
LDA ES_Y,X
SEC
SBC #$38
SEC
SBC $63
AND #$06
ASL
STA T0
LDA ES_X,X
AND #$03
ORA T0
CLC
ADC #SHOT_CHAR
LDY #$00
STA ($FB),Y
ESDrawNext:
DEX
BPL ESDraw
RTS

nodes.title: Enemies take turns to
code: Enemies take turns to shoot, every FIRE_RATE frames; TURRETs fire when the SPAWNER cues them. Spinners (FAN) fire four ways along their spokes. The rest aim at the ship (16 directions).

nodes.title: A shot is a pellet char
code: A shot is a pellet char (TILES 120-135: 4 x 4 positions in a cell). It is rubbed out before the scroll and drawn again after it. Rock stops it, and so do our shot, DOUBLE and MISSILE.
nodes.custom_title: A shot is a pellet char

nodes.title: WEAPONS
code:
WEAPONS
Shot or LASER, DOUBLE, homing MISSILE and the OPTION. Shots fly over the rock and blow up bunkers.

nodes.title: FIRE WEAPONS
code:
; WEAPONS - FIRE WEAPONS
; State: PLAYER_XL PLAYER_XH PLAYER_Y SHOT_ON SHOT_XL SHOT_XH
;        SHOT_Y DBL_ON DBL_XL DBL_XH DBL_Y MSL_ON MSL_XL MSL_XH
;        MSL_Y HAS_MISSILE HAS_DOUBLE
;
; FireWeapons - fire pressed: launch every weapon that is free.
FireWeapons:
LDA SHOT_ON
BNE FireDouble
LDA #$01
STA SHOT_ON
LDA PLAYER_XL      ; from the ship's nose
STA SHOT_XL
LDA PLAYER_XH
STA SHOT_XH
LDA PLAYER_Y
SEC
SBC #$0C
STA SHOT_Y
JSR FireSound

FireDouble:
LDA HAS_DOUBLE
BEQ FireMissile
LDA DBL_ON
BNE FireMissile
LDA #$01
STA DBL_ON
LDA PLAYER_XL      ; from the left wing
SEC
SBC #$04
STA DBL_XL
LDA PLAYER_XH
SBC #$00
STA DBL_XH
LDA PLAYER_Y
SEC
SBC #$06
STA DBL_Y

FireMissile:
LDA HAS_MISSILE
BEQ FireDone
LDA MSL_ON
BNE FireDone
LDA #$01
STA MSL_ON
LDA PLAYER_XL
STA MSL_XL
LDA PLAYER_XH
STA MSL_XH
LDA PLAYER_Y
SEC
SBC #$08
STA MSL_Y
FireDone:
RTS

nodes.title: SHOT + DOUBLE
code:
; WEAPONS - SHOT + DOUBLE
; State: SHOT_ON SHOT_XL SHOT_XH SHOT_Y DBL_ON DBL_XL DBL_XH
;        DBL_Y PROBE_XL PROBE_XH PROBE_Y T0 HAS_LASER
;
; Weapons - move everything the ship has fired.
; Speeds in pixels per frame - on the WEAPONS panel.
SHOT_SPEED = 6
LASER_SPEED = 9
DOUBLE_SPEED = 4
SHOT_TOP = $40     ; above this the shot has gone under the HUD

Weapons:
JSR MoveShot
JSR MoveDouble
JMP MoveMissile

; The shot (or laser) flies up until the top of the screen.
MoveShot:
LDA SHOT_ON
BNE ShotLive
RTS
ShotLive:
LDA #SHOT_SPEED
LDY HAS_LASER
BEQ ShotStep
LDA #LASER_SPEED
ShotStep:
STA T0
LDA SHOT_Y
SEC
SBC T0
BCC ShotGone
STA SHOT_Y
CMP #SHOT_TOP
BCS ShotTerrain
ShotGone:
LDA #$00
STA SHOT_ON
RTS
; Whatever is under the tip of the shot: a bunker is blown up.
ShotTerrain:
LDA SHOT_XL
CLC
ADC #$0B
STA PROBE_XL
LDA SHOT_XH
ADC #$00
STA PROBE_XH
LDA SHOT_Y
CLC
ADC #$03
STA PROBE_Y
JSR ProbeChar
JSR TerrainHit
BCS ShotGone
RTS

; DOUBLE flies up and left at 45 degrees.
MoveDouble:
LDA DBL_ON
BNE DoubleLive
RTS
DoubleLive:
LDA DBL_XL
SEC
SBC #DOUBLE_SPEED
STA DBL_XL
LDA DBL_XH
SBC #$00
STA DBL_XH
BMI DoubleGone
BNE DoubleUp
LDA DBL_XL
CMP #$08
BCC DoubleGone
DoubleUp:
LDA DBL_Y
SEC
SBC #DOUBLE_SPEED
BCC DoubleGone
STA DBL_Y
CMP #SHOT_TOP
BCC DoubleGone
LDA DBL_XL
CLC
ADC #$07
STA PROBE_XL
LDA DBL_XH
ADC #$00
STA PROBE_XH
LDA DBL_Y
CLC
ADC #$06
STA PROBE_Y
JSR ProbeChar
JSR TerrainHit
BCS DoubleGone
RTS
DoubleGone:
LDA #$00
STA DBL_ON
RTS

nodes.title: MISSILE
code:
; WEAPONS - MISSILE
; State: MSL_ON MSL_XL MSL_XH MSL_Y MSL_TGT PROBE_XL PROBE_XH
;        PROBE_Y
;
; MISSILE - homes in on an enemy: it picks the first SPAWNER slot
; that is flying and steers towards it, MISSILE_SPEED pixels a frame
; on each axis. With nothing to chase (or homing off) it flies
; straight up. On the WEAPONS panel:
MISSILE_SPEED = 3
MISSILE_HOMING = 1   ; 0 = straight up, like a second shot

MoveMissile:
LDA MSL_ON
BNE MissileLive
RTS
MissileLive:
.IF MISSILE_HOMING == 1
; Still chasing a live enemy? Otherwise look for another.
LDX MSL_TGT
LDA SPN_ON,X
BNE MissileSteer
LDX #$02
MissileFind:
LDA SPN_ON,X
BNE MissileFound
DEX
BPL MissileFind
JMP MissileStraight
MissileFound:
STX MSL_TGT
; Across: compare the 9-bit X positions, then step that way.
MissileSteer:
LDA MSL_XL
CMP SPN_XL,X
LDA MSL_XH
SBC SPN_XH,X
BCS MissileLeft
LDA MSL_XL
CLC
ADC #MISSILE_SPEED
STA MSL_XL
LDA MSL_XH
ADC #$00
STA MSL_XH
JMP MissileVertical
MissileLeft:
LDA MSL_XL
SEC
SBC #MISSILE_SPEED
STA MSL_XL
LDA MSL_XH
SBC #$00
STA MSL_XH
; Up or down, towards the enemy.
MissileVertical:
LDA MSL_Y
CMP SPN_Y,X
BCC MissileDown
SEC
SBC #MISSILE_SPEED
STA MSL_Y
JMP MissileCheck
MissileDown:
CLC
ADC #MISSILE_SPEED
STA MSL_Y
JMP MissileCheck
.ENDIF
MissileStraight:
LDA MSL_Y
SEC
SBC #MISSILE_SPEED
BCC MissileGone
STA MSL_Y

; Off the screen, or into a bunker?
MissileCheck:
LDA MSL_Y
CMP #$40          ; under the HUD at the top
BCC MissileGone
CMP #$F8
BCS MissileGone
LDA MSL_XH
BMI MissileGone
BEQ MissileProbe
LDA MSL_XL
CMP #$48
BCS MissileGone
MissileProbe:
LDA MSL_XL
CLC
ADC #$0B
STA PROBE_XL
LDA MSL_XH
ADC #$00
STA PROBE_XH
LDA MSL_Y
CLC
ADC #$06
STA PROBE_Y
JSR ProbeChar
JSR TerrainHit
BCS MissileGone
RTS
MissileGone:
LDA #$00
STA MSL_ON
RTS

nodes.title: OPTION
code:
; WEAPONS - OPTION
; State: PLAYER_XL PLAYER_XH PLAYER_Y OPT_XL OPT_XH OPT_Y
;        TRAIL_POS TRAIL_XL TRAIL_XH TRAIL_Y
;
; OPTION - an orb that follows the ship's path OPTION_GAP moves
; behind. It destroys any enemy it touches (Hits). A C64 has eight
; sprites and every one is in use, so this OPTION rams instead of
; firing - free a sprite to give it a shot of its own.
OPTION_GAP = 12    ; on the WEAPONS panel, 4-30

; The trail is 32 positions; a new one is stored only when the
; ship moves, so a still ship keeps its OPTION where it is.
OptionMove:
LDY TRAIL_POS
LDA PLAYER_XL
CMP TRAIL_XL,Y
BNE TrailPush
LDA PLAYER_Y
CMP TRAIL_Y,Y
BEQ TrailRead
TrailPush:
INY
TYA
AND #$1F
STA TRAIL_POS
TAY
LDA PLAYER_XL
STA TRAIL_XL,Y
LDA PLAYER_XH
STA TRAIL_XH,Y
LDA PLAYER_Y
STA TRAIL_Y,Y
TrailRead:
LDA TRAIL_POS
SEC
SBC #OPTION_GAP
AND #$1F
TAY
LDA TRAIL_XL,Y
STA OPT_XL
LDA TRAIL_XH,Y
STA OPT_XH
LDA TRAIL_Y,Y
STA OPT_Y
RTS

nodes.title: Each weapon asks ProbeChar
code: Each weapon asks ProbeChar (COLLISIONS) what char is at its tip, then TerrainHit decides: a bunker is blown up, rock is flown over (or stops it: RULES panel).

nodes.title: All 8 sprites are in use,
code: All 8 sprites are in use, so the OPTION rams enemies instead of shooting.

nodes.title: COLLISIONS / LIVES
code:
COLLISIONS / LIVES
Ship vs canyon and enemies, weapons vs enemies, score, shield and lives.

nodes.title: HITS
code:
; COLLISIONS / LIVES - HITS
; State: PLAYER_XL PLAYER_XH PLAYER_Y PLAYER_BOOM INVULN LIVES
;        SCORE1 SCORE2 EN_BOOM EN_BXL EN_BXH EN_BY SHOT_ON
;        SHOT_XL SHOT_XH SHOT_Y DBL_ON DBL_XL DBL_XH DBL_Y
;        MSL_ON MSL_XL MSL_XH MSL_Y OPT_XL OPT_XH OPT_Y CAP_ON
;        CAP_SLOT CAP_XL CAP_XH CAP_Y BOX_XL BOX_XH BOX_Y BOX_W
;        BOX_H T0 HAS_LASER HAS_OPTION SHIELD
;
; Hits - the ship against walls and enemies, and every weapon
; against every enemy. On the RULES panel:
WALLS_KILL = 1     ; 1 = flying into the canyon walls costs a ship
DROPS = 1          ; 1 = types with a DROP leave a capsule behind

Hits:
LDA PLAYER_BOOM
BEQ HitsAlive
RTS
HitsAlive:
LDA INVULN
BEQ HitsWalls
DEC INVULN
JMP HitsEnemies
HitsWalls:
.IF WALLS_KILL == 1
JSR ShipVsTerrain
BCC HitsEnemies
JSR ShipHit
.ENDIF

HitsEnemies:
LDX #$02
HitLoop:
LDA SPN_ON,X
BNE HitShip
JMP HitNext

; the ship (skipped while invulnerable)
HitShip:
LDA INVULN
ORA PLAYER_BOOM
BNE HitShot
LDA PLAYER_XL
STA BOX_XL
LDA PLAYER_XH
STA BOX_XH
LDA PLAYER_Y
STA BOX_Y
LDA #$0C
STA BOX_W
LDA #$0E
STA BOX_H
JSR BoxVsEnemy
BCS HitShot
LDA #$FF          ; ramming destroys it outright
JSR HitEnemy
JSR ShipHit
JMP HitNext

; the shot - a LASER keeps going through
HitShot:
LDA SHOT_ON
BEQ HitDouble
LDA SHOT_XL
STA BOX_XL
LDA SHOT_XH
STA BOX_XH
LDA SHOT_Y
STA BOX_Y
LDA #$09
STA BOX_W
LDA #$0E
STA BOX_H
JSR BoxVsEnemy
BCS HitDouble
LDA HAS_LASER
BNE HitShotKill
LDA #$00
STA SHOT_ON
HitShotKill:
LDA #$01
JSR HitEnemy
JMP HitNext

HitDouble:
LDA DBL_ON
BEQ HitMissile
LDA DBL_XL
STA BOX_XL
LDA DBL_XH
STA BOX_XH
LDA DBL_Y
STA BOX_Y
LDA #$0C
STA BOX_W
STA BOX_H
JSR BoxVsEnemy
BCS HitMissile
LDA #$00
STA DBL_ON
LDA #$01
JSR HitEnemy
JMP HitNext

HitMissile:
LDA MSL_ON
BEQ HitOption
LDA MSL_XL
STA BOX_XL
LDA MSL_XH
STA BOX_XH
LDA MSL_Y
STA BOX_Y
LDA #$0C
STA BOX_W
STA BOX_H
JSR BoxVsEnemy
BCS HitOption
LDA #$00
STA MSL_ON
LDA #$02          ; a missile hits twice as hard
JSR HitEnemy
JMP HitNext

HitOption:
LDA HAS_OPTION
BEQ HitNext
LDA OPT_XL
STA BOX_XL
LDA OPT_XH
STA BOX_XH
LDA OPT_Y
STA BOX_Y
LDA #$0E
STA BOX_W
LDA #$0C
STA BOX_H
JSR BoxVsEnemy
BCS HitNext
LDA #$01
JSR HitEnemy

HitNext:
DEX
BMI HitsDone
JMP HitLoop
HitsDone:
RTS

; HitEnemy - X = slot, A = damage. SPN_Hit takes it off the entity's HP
; (its type's HP in the spawn layer); carry set = destroyed: explosion,
; its type's POINTS, and a capsule if its type has a DROP.
HitEnemy:
JSR SPN_Hit
BCS EnemyDown
RTS
EnemyDown:
LDA SPN_XL,X
STA EN_BXL,X
LDA SPN_XH,X
STA EN_BXH,X
LDA SPN_Y,X
STA EN_BY,X
LDA #$18
STA EN_BOOM,X
LDY SPN_TYPE,X
LDA SPN_T_PTS,Y
JSR AddHundreds
JSR ExplosionSound
.IF DROPS == 1
LDY SPN_TYPE,X
LDA SPN_T_DROP,Y
BEQ KillDone
LDA CAP_ON
BNE KillDone
LDA #$01
STA CAP_ON
STX CAP_SLOT
LDA SPN_XL,X
STA CAP_XL
LDA SPN_XH,X
STA CAP_XH
LDA SPN_Y,X
STA CAP_Y
.ENDIF
KillDone:
RTS

; AddHundreds - A = how many hundreds to add (0-99).
AddHundreds:
STA T0
AddHundredsLoop:
LDA T0
BEQ AddHundredsDone
LDA #$01
JSR AddScore
DEC T0
JMP AddHundredsLoop
AddHundredsDone:
RTS

; ShipHit - a SHIELD soaks the hit, otherwise the ship bursts.
ShipHit:
LDA SHIELD
BEQ ShipBurst
DEC SHIELD
LDA #$30
STA INVULN
JMP ExplosionSound
ShipBurst:
LDA #$20
STA PLAYER_BOOM
LDA #$00
STA SHOT_ON
STA DBL_ON
STA MSL_ON
DEC LIVES
JMP ExplosionSound

; AddScore - A = points in hundreds (BCD).
AddScore:
SED
CLC
ADC SCORE1
STA SCORE1
LDA SCORE2
ADC #$00
STA SCORE2
CLD
RTS

nodes.title: TERRAIN
code:
; COLLISIONS / LIVES - TERRAIN
; State: PLAYER_XL PLAYER_XH PLAYER_Y PROBE_XL PROBE_XH PROBE_Y
;
; The scenery. Chars are tagged in the TILES charset (char editor:
; right-click a char to set its tag). The WORLD SCROLLER emits
; the tags as WORLD_TILE_TYPES. You look down on the canyon, so
; shots fly over the rock and blow up the bunkers they cross.
; On the RULES panel:
WALL_TAG = 1           ; canyon rock: wrecks the ship
TARGET_TAG = 2         ; bunkers: any shot blows them up
TARGET_POINTS = 3      ; score for a bunker, in hundreds (BCD)
ROCK_STOPS_SHOTS = 0   ; 1 = shots hit the rock instead of flying over

; TILES chars a bunker is made of, and its wreckage.
CH_HATCH_L = 108
CH_HATCH_R = 109
CH_RUBBLE = 110

; TerrainHit - A = tag from ProbeChar.
; Out: carry set = the weapon is stopped (a bunker is blown up too).
TerrainHit:
.IF ROCK_STOPS_SHOTS == 1
CMP #WALL_TAG
BEQ TerrainStop
.ENDIF
CMP #TARGET_TAG
BEQ TerrainTarget
CLC
RTS
TerrainTarget:
JSR BlastTarget
TerrainStop:
SEC
RTS

; BlastTarget - ($FB) is a bunker char: both halves become rubble.
BlastTarget:
LDY #$00
LDA ($FB),Y
CMP #CH_HATCH_R
BNE BlastPair
LDA $FB          ; right half hit: step back to the left half
BNE BlastDecLo
DEC $FC
BlastDecLo:
DEC $FB
BlastPair:
LDA #CH_RUBBLE
STA ($FB),Y
INY
STA ($FB),Y
LDA #TARGET_POINTS
JSR AddScore
JMP ExplosionSound

; ShipVsTerrain - carry set when the nose or a wing tip is in rock.
ShipVsTerrain:
LDA #$0B
LDY #$01
JSR ShipProbe
BCS ShipTerrainDone
LDA #$02
LDY #$0E
JSR ShipProbe
BCS ShipTerrainDone
LDA #$15
LDY #$0E
JSR ShipProbe
ShipTerrainDone:
RTS

; ShipProbe - A / Y = x / y offset into the ship sprite.
ShipProbe:
CLC
ADC PLAYER_XL
STA PROBE_XL
LDA PLAYER_XH
ADC #$00
STA PROBE_XH
TYA
CLC
ADC PLAYER_Y
STA PROBE_Y
JSR ProbeChar
CMP #WALL_TAG
BEQ ShipSolid
CMP #TARGET_TAG
BEQ ShipSolid
CLC
RTS
ShipSolid:
SEC
RTS

nodes.title: BOX TEST
code:
; COLLISIONS / LIVES - BOX TEST
; State: PLAYER_XL PLAYER_XH PLAYER_Y BOX_XL BOX_XH BOX_Y BOX_W
;        BOX_H TGT_XL TGT_XH TGT_Y T0 T1
;
; BoxTest - do two sprites overlap?
;  In: BOX_XL/BOX_XH/BOX_Y  one sprite's position
;      TGT_XL/TGT_XH/TGT_Y  the other's (BoxVsShip / BoxVsEnemy set it)
;      BOX_W / BOX_H        how close counts as touching, in pixels
; Out: carry clear = touching. X and Y are kept.
; Every ACTORS frame is drawn centred, so comparing the sprites'
; corners compares their middles.
BoxVsShip:
LDA PLAYER_XL
STA TGT_XL
LDA PLAYER_XH
STA TGT_XH
LDA PLAYER_Y
STA TGT_Y
JMP BoxTest

BoxVsEnemy:
LDA SPN_XL,X
STA TGT_XL
LDA SPN_XH,X
STA TGT_XH
LDA SPN_Y,X
STA TGT_Y

BoxTest:
LDA BOX_XL
SEC
SBC TGT_XL
STA T0
LDA BOX_XH
SBC TGT_XH
STA T1           ; T1:T0 = distance in X, signed
LDA T0
CLC
ADC BOX_W
STA T0
LDA T1
ADC #$00
BNE BoxMiss      ; more than 255 apart, either way
LDA BOX_W
ASL
STA T1
LDA T0
CMP T1
BCS BoxMiss
LDA BOX_Y
SEC
SBC TGT_Y
CLC
ADC BOX_H
STA T0
LDA BOX_H
ASL
STA T1
LDA T0
CMP T1
BCS BoxMiss
CLC
RTS
BoxMiss:
SEC
RTS

nodes.title: PROBE CHAR
code:
; COLLISIONS / LIVES - PROBE CHAR
; State: PROBE_XL PROBE_XH PROBE_Y PROBE_COL PROBE_CHAR T0
;
; ProbeChar - which char is under a point, and what is its tag?
;  In: PROBE_XL/PROBE_XH/PROBE_Y, a point in sprite coordinates.
; Out: A = the char's tag (0 = untagged, off screen or in the HUD),
;      $FB/$FC + Y=0 = the char on the screen.
; $63 is the WORLD SCROLLER's fine Y. V never scrolls sideways:
; 40 columns, no fine X.
ProbeNone:
LDA #$00
RTS

ProbeChar:
; column = (X - 24) / 8
LDA PROBE_XL
SEC
SBC #$18
STA T0
LDA PROBE_XH
SBC #$00
BMI ProbeNone
LSR
ROR T0
LSR
ROR T0
LSR
ROR T0
LDA T0
CMP #$28
BCS ProbeNone
STA PROBE_COL
; row = (Y - 56 - fine Y) / 8: row 3 starts on line 80 + fine Y (see
; FIXED HUD / RASTER). Rows 0-2 are the HUD.
LDA PROBE_Y
SEC
SBC #$38
BCC ProbeNone
SEC
SBC $63
BCC ProbeNone
LSR
LSR
LSR
CMP #$03
BCC ProbeNone
CMP #$19
BCS ProbeNone
; $FB/$FC = $0400 + row * 40 + column
TAY
LDA ProbeRowLo,Y
CLC
ADC PROBE_COL
STA $FB
LDA ProbeRowHi,Y
ADC #$00
STA $FC
LDY #$00
LDA ($FB),Y
STA PROBE_CHAR
; Look it up in WORLD_TILE_TYPES: [char, tag] pairs, $FF ends.
ProbeScan:
LDA WORLD_TILE_TYPES,Y
CMP #$FF
BEQ ProbeNone
CMP PROBE_CHAR
BEQ ProbeTag
INY
INY
BNE ProbeScan
JMP ProbeNone
ProbeTag:
INY
LDA WORLD_TILE_TYPES,Y
RTS

ProbeRowLo:
.byte $00,$28,$50,$78,$A0,$C8,$F0,$18,$40,$68,$90,$B8,$E0,$08,$30,$58,$80,$A8,$D0,$F8,$20,$48,$70,$98,$C0
ProbeRowHi:
.byte $04,$04,$04,$04,$04,$04,$04,$05,$05,$05,$05,$05,$05,$06,$06,$06,$06,$06,$06,$06,$07,$07,$07,$07,$07

nodes.title: Tags come from TILES: rock
code: Tags come from TILES: rock chars are T1, bunker chars T2. Tag new chars the same way and they just work.

nodes.title: ProbeChar reads the char
code: ProbeChar reads the char under a point straight off the screen, so a blown-up bunker stays rubble until it scrolls away.

nodes.title: SPRITE DRAW
code:
SPRITE DRAW
Game state into the VIC:
positions (9-bit X), frames, colours, blinking and explosions.

nodes.title: DRAW ACTORS
code:
; SPRITE DRAW - DRAW ACTORS
; State: PLAYER_XL PLAYER_XH PLAYER_Y SHIP_TILT PLAYER_BOOM
;        INVULN ANIM SHOT_ON SHOT_XL SHOT_XH SHOT_Y DBL_ON
;        DBL_XL DBL_XH DBL_Y MSL_ON MSL_XL MSL_XH MSL_Y OPT_XL
;        OPT_XH OPT_Y D_XL D_XH D_Y D_PTR D_COL SPR_ON SPR_MSB
;        HAS_LASER HAS_OPTION SHIELD
;
; DrawActors - copy the game state into the VIC sprite registers.
; Sprites: 0 ship, 1 shot/laser, 2 DOUBLE, 3 MISSILE, 4 OPTION,
; 5-7 the three SPAWNER slots (or the capsule, in a free slot).
; Colours - on the COLOURS panel (enemy colours are their spawn types).
SHIP_COL = 1
SHIELD_COL = 14
SHOT_COL = 7
LASER_COL = 3
MISSILE_COL = 10
OPTION_COL = 8
CAPSULE_COL = 2
BOOM_COL = 7

; ACTORS frames as sprite pointers ($2800 / 64 = $A0 is frame 0).
FR_BASE = $A0
FR_SHIP = $A0
FR_SHIP_FLAME = $A1   ; +1 bank left, +2 bank right
FR_SHOT = $A4
FR_LASER = $A5
FR_DOUBLE = $A6
FR_MISSILE = $A7
FR_OPTION = $A8
FR_CAPSULE = $B2
FR_BOOM = $B4

DrawActors:
LDA #$00
STA SPR_ON
STA SPR_MSB

; --- sprite 0: the ship ---
LDA PLAYER_XL
STA D_XL
LDA PLAYER_XH
STA D_XH
LDA PLAYER_Y
STA D_Y
LDA PLAYER_BOOM
BEQ ShipFlying
JSR BoomFrame
JMP ShipPut
ShipFlying:
LDA INVULN          ; blink while it cannot be hit
AND #$04
BNE DrawShot
LDA SHIP_TILT
BEQ ShipLevel
CLC
ADC #FR_SHIP_FLAME
STA D_PTR
JMP ShipColour
ShipLevel:
LDA ANIM            ; exhaust flicker
AND #$02
LSR
CLC
ADC #FR_SHIP
STA D_PTR
ShipColour:
LDA #SHIP_COL
LDY SHIELD
BEQ ShipColourSet
LDA #SHIELD_COL
ShipColourSet:
STA D_COL
ShipPut:
LDX #$00
JSR PutSprite

; --- sprite 1: shot or laser ---
DrawShot:
LDA SHOT_ON
BEQ DrawDouble
LDA SHOT_XL
STA D_XL
LDA SHOT_XH
STA D_XH
LDA SHOT_Y
STA D_Y
LDA #FR_SHOT
LDY #SHOT_COL
LDX HAS_LASER
BEQ ShotLook
LDA #FR_LASER
LDY #LASER_COL
ShotLook:
STA D_PTR
STY D_COL
LDX #$01
JSR PutSprite

; --- sprite 2: DOUBLE ---
DrawDouble:
LDA DBL_ON
BEQ DrawMissile
LDA DBL_XL
STA D_XL
LDA DBL_XH
STA D_XH
LDA DBL_Y
STA D_Y
LDA #FR_DOUBLE
STA D_PTR
LDA #SHOT_COL
STA D_COL
LDX #$02
JSR PutSprite

; --- sprite 3: MISSILE ---
DrawMissile:
LDA MSL_ON
BEQ DrawOption
LDA MSL_XL
STA D_XL
LDA MSL_XH
STA D_XH
LDA MSL_Y
STA D_Y
LDA #FR_MISSILE
STA D_PTR
LDA #MISSILE_COL
STA D_COL
LDX #$03
JSR PutSprite

; --- sprite 4: OPTION ---
DrawOption:
LDA HAS_OPTION
BEQ DrawEnemies
LDA PLAYER_BOOM
BNE DrawEnemies
LDA OPT_XL
STA D_XL
LDA OPT_XH
STA D_XH
LDA OPT_Y
STA D_Y
LDA ANIM
LSR
LSR
LSR
AND #$01
CLC
ADC #FR_OPTION
STA D_PTR
LDA #OPTION_COL
STA D_COL
LDX #$04
JSR PutSprite

nodes.title: DRAW ENEMIES
code:
; SPRITE DRAW - DRAW ENEMIES
; State: ANIM EN_BOOM EN_BXL EN_BXH EN_BY CAP_ON CAP_SLOT CAP_XL
;        CAP_XH CAP_Y D_XL D_XH D_Y D_PTR D_COL SPR_ON SPR_MSB
;        T2
;
; --- sprites 5-7: SPAWNER slots 0-2 ---
; A live entity shows its type's frame pair (SPN_T_PTR + 0 / 1) and
; colour; otherwise the slot's explosion; otherwise the capsule, if it
; is borrowing this slot.
DrawEnemies:
LDA #$02
STA T2
DrawEnemyLoop:
LDY T2
LDA SPN_ON,Y
BEQ DrawEnemyBoom
LDA SPN_XL,Y
STA D_XL
LDA SPN_XH,Y
STA D_XH
LDA SPN_Y,Y
STA D_Y
LDA SPN_TYPE,Y
TAX
LDA ANIM            ; two frames, swapped every 8 frames
LSR
LSR
LSR
AND #$01
CLC
ADC SPN_T_PTR,X
STA D_PTR
LDA SPN_T_COL,X
STA D_COL
JMP DrawEnemyPut
DrawEnemyBoom:
LDA EN_BOOM,Y
BEQ DrawCapsule
LDA EN_BXL,Y
STA D_XL
LDA EN_BXH,Y
STA D_XH
LDA EN_BY,Y
STA D_Y
LDA EN_BOOM,Y
JSR BoomFrame
DrawEnemyPut:
LDA T2
CLC
ADC #$05
TAX
JSR PutSprite
JMP DrawEnemyNext

; A free slot may be lending its sprite to the capsule.
DrawCapsule:
LDA CAP_ON
BEQ DrawEnemyNext
CPY CAP_SLOT
BNE DrawEnemyNext
LDA CAP_XL
STA D_XL
LDA CAP_XH
STA D_XH
LDA CAP_Y
STA D_Y
LDA ANIM
LSR
LSR
AND #$01
CLC
ADC #FR_CAPSULE
STA D_PTR
LDA #CAPSULE_COL
STA D_COL
LDA ANIM            ; flash white
AND #$08
BEQ DrawEnemyPut
LDA #$01
STA D_COL
JMP DrawEnemyPut

DrawEnemyNext:
DEC T2
BMI DrawEnemiesDone
JMP DrawEnemyLoop
DrawEnemiesDone:

; All sprites placed: switch on exactly the ones in use.
LDA SPR_ON
STA $D015
LDA SPR_MSB
STA $D010
RTS

nodes.title: PUT SPRITE
code:
; SPRITE DRAW - PUT SPRITE
; State: D_XL D_XH D_Y D_PTR D_COL SPR_ON SPR_MSB
;
; PutSprite - sprite X (0-7) at D_XL/D_XH/D_Y, pointer D_PTR,
; colour D_COL; marks it in SPR_ON and the ninth-bit mask SPR_MSB.
; A sprite whose top is above PLAY_TOP would show over the HUD, so it
; stays switched off until it is all the way into the playfield.
PLAY_TOP = $4B
PutSprite:
LDA D_Y
CMP #PLAY_TOP
BCS PutShow
RTS
PutShow:
LDA D_PTR
STA $07F8,X
LDA D_COL
STA $D027,X
LDA SprBit,X
ORA SPR_ON
STA SPR_ON
LDA D_XH
BEQ PutLowX
LDA SprBit,X
ORA SPR_MSB
STA SPR_MSB
PutLowX:
TXA
ASL
TAY
LDA D_XL
STA $D000,Y
LDA D_Y
STA $D001,Y
RTS
SprBit:
.byte $01,$02,$04,$08,$10,$20,$40,$80

; BoomFrame - A = explosion timer -> one of the four BOOM frames.
BoomFrame:
LSR
LSR
LSR
CMP #$04
BCC BoomStep
LDA #$03
BoomStep:
EOR #$03          ; counts down, so big timer = first frame
CLC
ADC #FR_BOOM
STA D_PTR
LDA #BOOM_COL
STA D_COL
RTS

nodes.title: Enemy frame = its spawn
code: Enemy frame = its spawn type FRAME + 0 or 1, swapped every 8 frames, so enemy frames come in pairs in ACTORS.

nodes.title: Sprites past X = 255 need
code: Sprites past X = 255 need their bit in $D010. SPR_MSB collects them, written once at the end.

nodes.title: HUD VALUES
code:
HUD VALUES
Score, high score and ships into the HUD, and the meter slot colours.

nodes.title: STATUS
code:
; HUD VALUES - STATUS
; State: LIVES ANIM SCORE1 SCORE2 METER POWERS HI1 HI2
;
; Status - numbers and meter colours into the fixed HUD (rows 0-2,
; drawn by the TOP STATUS macro from the STATUS asset).
; Meter colours - on the HUD panel.
METER_COL = 14       ; a slot you can buy
METER_LIT_COL = 7    ; the lit slot (flashes white)
METER_OWNED_COL = 11 ; a power you already own

Status:
LDY #$07          ; score at row 0, column 7 (the HUD adds "00")
LDA SCORE2
JSR PutBcd
LDA SCORE1
JSR PutBcd
LDY #$14          ; high score at column 20
LDA HI2
JSR PutBcd
LDA HI1
JSR PutBcd
LDA LIVES         ; ships at column 37
CLC
ADC #$30
STA $0425

; Meter word n is 5 cells of colour RAM at row 1, column 2 + 6n.
LDX #$00
LDY #$00
MeterLoop:
JSR MeterColour
STA $D82A,Y
STA $D82B,Y
STA $D82C,Y
STA $D82D,Y
STA $D82E,Y
TYA
CLC
ADC #$06
TAY
INX
CPX #$06
BNE MeterLoop
RTS

; MeterColour - A = colour for meter slot X (0-5).
MeterColour:
TXA
CLC
ADC #$01
CMP METER
BNE MeterNotLit
LDA ANIM
AND #$08
BEQ MeterLit
LDA #$01
RTS
MeterLit:
LDA #METER_LIT_COL
RTS
MeterNotLit:
CPX #$00          ; SPEED can be bought again
BEQ MeterNormal
LDA POWERS,X
BEQ MeterNormal
LDA #METER_OWNED_COL
RTS
MeterNormal:
LDA #METER_COL
RTS

; PutBcd - BCD byte A as two digits at $0400 + Y; Y moves on by 2.
PutBcd:
PHA
LSR
LSR
LSR
LSR
CLC
ADC #$30
STA $0400,Y
INY
PLA
AND #$0F
CLC
ADC #$30
STA $0400,Y
INY
RTS

nodes.title: FIXED HUD / RASTER
code:
FIXED HUD / RASTER
The IRQ callbacks: HUD steady and hires, then the scrolling multicolour playfield.

nodes.title: HUD SPLIT
code:
; FIXED HUD / RASTER - HUD SPLIT
;
; The raster IRQ callbacks (STARTUP column). The HUD rows are hires
; and never scroll; the playfield below is multicolour, 40 columns (it
; only scrolls up and down), with the WORLD SCROLLER's fine Y ($63).
;
; The VIC starts a char row on any line whose low 3 bits equal fine Y,
; so the playfield's first row can only start on line 80 + fine Y. Fine
; Y has to reach the VIC late enough that no earlier line matches it,
; or the world jumps a char every 8 pixels:
;   line 72  park fine Y on 1 - no line from 74 to 79 matches it
;   line 78  the real fine Y (line 80 for fine Y 7), in ECM + multicolour:
;            an invalid mode, so the rows still starting show black
;   line 86  switch ECM off at the end of line 88
; Lines 75-88 are a black band under the HUD that hides the row edge;
; the playfield shows from line 89.
HudFixed:
LDA #$1B          ; fine Y 3: HUD row 0 starts on the first visible line
STA $D011
LDA #$08
STA $D016
RTS

HudPlayfield:
LDA $D012
CMP #$4A          ; wait for line 74 (HUD row 2's last line)
BCC HudPlayfield
LDA #$11          ; fine Y 1, before line 75 can start a row
STA $D011
RTS

HudScroll:
LDA $63
AND #$07
TAX
ORA #$50          ; ECM + screen on + fine Y
TAY
LDA #$4F          ; line 79
CPX #$07
BNE HudScrollWait
LDA #$50          ; fine Y 7 would match line 79 itself: line 80
HudScrollWait:
CMP $D012
BCC HudScrollSet  ; past the line
BNE HudScrollWait ; not there yet
HudScrollSet:
STY $D011
LDA #$18          ; multicolour, 40 columns
STA $D016
RTS

; Line 88 starts a char row when fine Y is 0, and the VIC then holds the
; CPU until the right border - so the switch lands there for every fine
; Y: the other seven wait the same time in a delay loop. Line 88 stays
; black, the playfield shows from line 89.
HudReveal:
LDA $63
AND #$07
TAX
ORA #$10          ; ECM off: the playfield shows
TAY
HudRevealWait:
LDA $D012
CMP #$58          ; line 88
BCC HudRevealWait
CPX #$00
BEQ HudRevealSet  ; fine Y 0: the char row fetch is the delay
LDX #$08
HudRevealDelay:
DEX
BNE HudRevealDelay
HudRevealSet:
STY $D011
RTS

HudNmi:
RTI
